demographics.usage_behavior: I browse my photos often but rarely use search

retrieval_story.photo_type: A photo from a trip or vacation
retrieval_story.what_remembered: Who was in it, Roughly where it was taken, Roughly when it was taken (month or year), What was happening in the scene, A color or visual detail, How it made me feel / the vibe, I could picture it clearly but couldn't describe it in words
retrieval_story.how_tried: Browsed through the People / Faces section, Scrolled through the timeline manually, Opened a specific album
retrieval_story.search_outcome: I didn't use the search bar
retrieval_story.how_ended: Found it quickly through search (under 2 minutes)
retrieval_story.frequency: Almost every time I look for something old

diagnostics.top_difficulties: I can picture the photo but can't describe it in search keywords, My screenshots and documents are mixed in with real photos, Photos from different phones/downloads have wrong dates, I don't trust the search to find everything, so I just scroll
diagnostics.stakes: Medium — wanted to share it with someone or post it
diagnostics.biggest_frustration: Finding a person or place is relatively fine and can manage, but finding the documents is the toughest part
diagnostics.search_sophistication: I know it has search but I'm not sure what to type
diagnostics.experience_story: Sorta true for both good and bad, I can pin point the time and type of photos, but since there are lots of pics even of the specific dates say 500-1000, find the one I want is very tricky
diagnostics.workarounds: Scroll through the timeline until I find it, Ask the other person who was there to send it, Give up and move on, Check WhatsApp/Instagram for the same photo
